title: quietly prevent recording abuse
context: Y1 Volume 4.5 final summer vacation episode. Later flashbacks and private narration do not imply global contemporaneous knowledge.
observed_actions: Privately executes Kiyotaka's protective countermeasure to prevent a group of boys from retaining images of girls changing.
observed_result: The perpetrators later find no usable material; Karuizawa completes her action without disclosing its purpose to nearby friends.
epistemic_limits: The scene is a prevention of a privacy violation, not approval or practical instruction for intrusive recording; she acts under a coercively asymmetric relationship with Kiyotaka.
information_available: Actor-scoped at actual event time only. Later source explanations can refine the dossier without backdating belief, especially in retrospective final chapter.
counterfactual_test: Different support, actor health, social context and private knowledge may change the result; no forced repetition or universal success.
